name: 资料群选择门
purpose: Compile proposed corpus families into an auditable gate that blocks whole-folder synthesis until a coherent family or verified cross-family question is explicitly selected.
eligibility_checks: ready families have verified scope evidence
assumptions: inventory identifiers and verified scope evidence describe the same locked source snapshot
human_gates: select one family or explicitly authorize a verified whole-corpus question
diagnostics: unassigned sources, family evidence failures, selection conflicts, and readiness counts
allowed_claims: whether a selected scope may proceed to analysis
forbidden_claims: largest family is the folder's core
